agent_registration.idempotency: server-derived from canonical registration payload for legacy Proto compatibility

agent_heartbeat.non_goal: one audit and outbox record per heartbeat tick

invariants: queued remains accepted until matching probe ACK
ACK is bound to probe, operation and config revision
duplicate or out-of-order ACK cannot regress state
probe registration commits authority revision, history, audit, outbox and durable replay result in one serializable transaction
an existing probe_id cannot be rebound to another tenant
an exact registration retry replays without creating a new revision
heartbeat updates only the authenticated tenant and probe liveness projection and never represents a business command as complete
domain.compensation: issue an approved previous config revision when the operation supports rollback

permissions.agent_ack_scope: authenticated Ingest Heartbeat with token probe_id bound to request identity
negative_tests: agent token cannot ACK another probe
stale ACK does not overwrite newer config

stop_conditions: unrecoverable control lag or ACK identity mismatch

tests: G1 registration transaction rollback and exact replay
G2 sentinel PostgreSQL registration revision and cross-tenant rejection
evidence: operation_id connects UI, PG, Kafka command, agent ACK, audit and final probe config
probe registration event_id connects PG revision, history, audit, outbox and durable replay result
